Simulation events

    Same owner failure, two policies

    A deterministic model, not a live network test. See Connections & backups for actual game reports. Simulated changes are independent of terrain generation and rendering.

    42 regions / 2,688 rendering tiles

    Independent seed per region · actual reported seed holders · owner-loss availability

    Replica convergence

    Whole beacon-store fingerprints, refreshed with peer heartbeats

    A matching fingerprint means the reported beacon store matches this observer. Seed holders are reported separately per region. Reports are trusted-LAN telemetry, not authenticated storage proofs. Copies on one laptop do not protect against laptop failure.

    Local persistence

    World limits in this build

    The battlefield is exactly 10 km × 10 km, with 42 independent regions arranged 7 × 6. Each region is divided into 8 × 8 rendering tiles, for 2,688 tiles total. Near, medium and distant tiles use different mesh detail; only nearby tiles have terrain collision.

    Backups ON retains seed manifests and world changes across peers. OFF keeps only an owner’s active seeds and changes; regions become unavailable when that owner expires. Enabling backups later cannot recreate lost changes. Gameplay elimination does not close a peer’s network process.
